name: Katapull Commerce Hub
description: Aggregated productscape of the Katapull group: the customers shared across Highbiza, EffectConnect, Vendit, Logic4, Transus, Picqer, DeliveryMatch and Returnista, the jobs they do and which Katapull platforms they use for each job, on a high-level brick map with one brick per platform plus the hub layer that connects them.
